name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 25 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-12-11, at wavelengths from 0.83 to 4.30 µm. The pipeline found 3 moving objects.
